Shanghai Municipal Police
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D. 93
Date ... 7 . 3 . 29
Wayside Police Station.
March 7 . 1929 .
REPORT ON A substance supposed to be Varnish.
Made by P/P.C.S. Coyne Forwarded by [Signature]
Sir,
At 9a.m. on March 7, a wheelbarrow was brought to the Station and on examining the contents of the tins thereon, I found a substance resembling opium. Accompanied by C.D.C. 156 Zah Pau Ying I visited 170 Khashing Road where, in a wooden structure, I found this substance in the process of making, also a large quantity stored on the premises. I then visited X322 North Shansi Road where I saw the person responsible for the sale and manufacture of this substance. This man claims that it is a varnish and that he has manufactured it in the Settlement for three years, he also admits that he is named Lee Koh Hua (李國華) Proprietor of Wha Chong Oil Press Factory, (See attached Newspaper extract) whom the Chinese Authorities were desirous of making the acquaintance of about three years ago for manufacturing a substance for the dilution of opium.
I bought a 2 lbs. tin of this substance and I think that were a chemical test applied, as applied to varnishes, the reaction would prove negative. Although I might point out that the label on the tin claims that this substance is different from other varnishes. I would also point out that no books are kept regarding the names and addresses of customers, Lee Koh Hua (李國華) stating that all his trade is with Hankow and river ports. By the appearance of the shop there does not seem to be much of a legitimate business. In view of these facts I think a chemical test might be applied to this substance and should the reaction prove negative, the person prosecuted under Art. 278 of the C.C.R.C.
Yours Obediently,
Senior Detective i/c Wayside. J. Coyne P/C.S. 42.

（左侧手写批注）：
After I came to conclusion that can used as varnish. There are 5 tins for ? and this only one 9/3 Pte
If this substance can be used as varnish, I do not think we have a case, as it becomes able buy this amount & even if with opium should be prosecuted against
K.C.S.
I suggest that the Customs refuse to let this substance pass through the Custom House as it is undoubtedly an adulterant.
J.W.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事侦缉处登记室
编号 I. O. D. 93
日期 ... 29 . 3 . 7
路边巡捕房。
1929年3月7日。
关于一种疑似清漆的物质的报告。
由警长 (P/P.C.S.) 科因 (Coyne) 制作 经由 [签名] 转呈
先生，
3月7日上午9时，一辆独轮车被推至巡捕房，在检查车上铁罐内的物品后，我发现了一种类似鸦片的物质。在刑事侦缉处警员 (C.D.C.) 156号扎保英 (Zah Pau Ying) 的陪同下，我前往喀什兴路 (Khashing Road) 170号，在一处木结构建筑内，我发现该物质正在制造中，且现场储存有大量该物质。随后我前往山西北路 (North Shansi Road) X322号，会见了负责销售和生产该物质的人。此人声称这是一种清漆，并称他在租界内生产该物质已有三年，他还承认自己名叫李国华 (Lee Koh Hua)，是华丰榨油厂 (Wha Chong Oil Press Factory) 的业主（见附件报纸摘录），约三年前中国当局曾希望结识他，因其生产一种用于稀释鸦片的物质。
我购买了一罐2磅装的该物质，我认为如果像对清漆那样进行化学测试，反应结果将为阴性。虽然我要指出，罐上的标签声称该物质与其他清漆不同。我还要指出，没有保留关于客户姓名和地址的账簿，李国华 (Lee Koh Hua) 称他的所有贸易对象均为汉口及沿江港口。从店铺的外观来看，似乎并没有多少合法生意。鉴于上述事实，我认为可以对该物质进行化学测试，如果反应结果为阴性，则应根据《中华民国刑法》第278条起诉此人。
此致，
敬礼
路边巡捕房高级侦探主管 J. 科因 (J. Coyne) 警长 (P/C.S.) 42号。

（左侧手写批注）：
在我得出结论认为其可用作清漆之后。有5罐用于？而这仅有一罐 3月9日 私人 (Pte)
如果该物质可用作清漆，我认为我们无权立案，因为购买此数量是合法的，即使其中混有鸦片也应被起诉
K.C.S.
我建议海关拒绝让该物质通过海关，因为它无疑是一种掺假物。
J.W.

pages.en:
Rough translation of a label attached to the Tin.
----------------

The undersigned has discovered the trade in Chinese
varnishes, which are Chinese products and exported to Foreign
Countries, is getting low owing to its irritable smell, and thus
the foreign varnishes are being used in preference to ours.
As our Chinese always adopt the old method and have no idea to
reform it, the exportation of our Chinese paint is nearly ceased.
The foreign paint is not so stable and easy to be defiled and
decayed. If our Chinese paint is reformed by diminishing the
irritable smell, the trade in that line will be restored. The
undersigned has invented the glue mixed with chemical liquid, which
would be far better than other paint when taking into use, as it
has no irritable smell and the brightness can last forever, and its
name is called "Sanitary Varnish", and the Trade Mark is registered
as "Flying Pongo".

Proprietor of Wha Chong Oil Press Factory,
Chung Shing Road, Chapei, Shai.
pages.zh:
附于铁罐上标签的大意翻译。
----------------

本人发现，作为
中国产品并出口到外国
的中国清漆贸易，因其刺激性气味
而日渐低迷，因此外商更倾向于使用
外国清漆而非我国产品。
由于我国商人始终沿用旧法，无意
改革，我国油漆的出口几乎停滞。
外国油漆不够稳定，易受污损和
变质。如果通过减少刺激性气味来
改革我国油漆，该行业的贸易将会恢复。
本人发明了混合化学液体的胶水，
在使用时远优于其他油漆，因为
它没有刺激性气味，且光泽可永久保持，其
名称称为“卫生清漆”，商标已注册
为“飞蓬哥” (Flying Pongo)。

华丰榨油厂业主，
上海闸北中兴路。
